reviews.text: Quick same day service. Didn't try to up-sell me.

I was hoping to change vets .First time there I was told by the receptionist I’m too early. Bad start, no hello no how are you. I’m too early after telling her my dogs name several times it just got worse. She demanded I tell her the last vet I saw, I was not going to tell her at this point as I think it’s none of there business. After much thought I said I changed my mind and I’m leaving. That’s it and I would not recommend this vet
I’ve been really happy with the care my dog has received here, including careful follow up. The whole staff were great.

OVERPRICED SERVICES. First off, they ask for 5 star reviews for a 10% discount. Came in for respiratory concerns with my cat. I was quoted $700 for an X-ray (that had to be another visit) after a $250 check-up. I decided to go to another animal hospital and they did the x-ray (check-up $124, x-ray $300). The difference in the service was also significant. The doctor here barely explained his assessment and was dismissive of my concerns for feline asthma. And guess what, the visit to the other vet did confirm feline asthma, and my cat was started on inhalers right away and has been doing well after a month of treatment. I suggest you go somewhere else.

I have been coming to this clinic for almost 10 years. Dr. Behrooz Tamjidi is an excellent veterinarian - confident, professional, courteous, and compassionate. He also maintains fair pricing and ethical administrative practices.

However, in recent years there has been significant turnover among the veterinarians. It has become difficult to establish a trusting, long-term relationship with a veterinarian who is familiar with your pet.

We have also had interactions with reception staff and veterinary assistants that felt condescending and off-putting.

Most disappointing was our experience with a new veterinarian last week. During our first appointment, he came across as condescending, socially awkward, and seemingly uncomfortable handling our dog, which did not inspire confidence.

When discussing treatment options, there were also concerning inconsistencies in the estimates we were provided. He gave us a clear verbal quote for the more affordable option but did not provide it in writing. The only written estimate we received was for the more expensive option. After reviewing it, we discovered it was approximately double the amount he had quoted verbally. Whether this was an oversight or a communication issue, it significantly undermined our confidence in the transparency of the process.

After nearly a decade as clients, we’ve decided this clinic is no longer one we can confidently recommend unless you’re fortunate enough to build a long-term relationship with a veterinarian you trust or are able to see Dr. Behrooz Tamjidi.
